name: Cost of production
summary: Works out what a grower or livestock producer spends to produce a crop, head or tonne, from the books, and checks it against budget. Crons read and draft into the workflow's own store; nothing leaves the business.

covered_by.cost-capture: draft (accounting.getReportProfitAndLoss, actuals cost lines from Xero)
covered_by.costs-by-block: not yet (Xero tracking categories are not read; see gaps)
covered_by.unit-cost: draft (cost per unit when settings.volume is set)
covered_by.price-margin: not yet (no sale price source in the mapped operations)
covered_by.record-keeping: draft (cost summaries in the workflow store)

crons.name: actuals
crons.summary: Read the season's cost lines from Xero and draft the cost summary with cost per unit.

crons.name: budget-compare
crons.summary: Read the season's budget and draft actual against budget for each cost account, every Monday.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads only. The only writes are summaries in the workflow's own store, which nobody outside the business sees. No live operation is needed for cost of production: nothing this workflow produces is sent, posted or booked.
gaps: figured: no platform folder in core/sdk/platforms, so no adapter. Its docs describe cost capture from Xero, MYOB or QuickBooks and crop-level margins, but no operation is mapped here.
traction-ag: no platform folder in core/sdk/platforms, so no adapter. Its docs show cost of production per block, but no operation is mapped here.
xero: block or paddock roll-ups need tracking categories (trackingCategoryID on the profit and loss report). Not read yet.
xero: supplier bills (accounting.getInvoices for ACCPAY) and how they are coded to a crop are not read yet.
xero: overhead allocation across enterprises has no mapped operation or doc steps. Manual journals are not read.
xero: price and margin per unit needs a sale price source. Xero invoices (accounting.getInvoices) would provide one, but they are not read yet.
Judgment steps stay with the person: scenario and what-if modelling, accountant review and tax treatment, lender and buyer reports, and the decision on crops, stock or selling time.
unit-cost needs settings.volume (hectares, head or tonnes) because Xero does not hold production volume.
Break-even is not computed. Xero holds no estimated yield or market price.
Confirm the workflow steps and platform coverage with the business before enabling its crons.
Budget compare sums every budget balance against actuals to date. It does not pro-rate the budget by period yet.
No live operation is mapped or needed, so the approval path (queue, approve, re-run) has nothing to run in this workflow.
